acceptanceCriteria: gateselect.Select narrows a read-scope declaration edit the same way as AFP-V0-050 (base declaration from Git objects, fail-closed to AFP-V0-023 when the base is unreadable or invalid), or a spec decision records why it must not.
A test shows an additive declaration edit selects only the new package through `corvint test` / gate-affected-select, and one mutation brings back the full selection.
body: Residual from the V1-1309/1310/1298 affected-tooling lane (PR #916, branch claude/affected-batch-1309-1310-1298, head c9f0f22ac, base 595359a1b). AFP-V0-050 narrows `corvint affected` to added/changed/removed read-scope keys by diffing against the base commit's declaration. gateselect.Select (used by cmd/corvint/test.go:397 for `corvint test`, and by gate-affected-select) still applies the AFP-V0-023 rule and selects every declared package. The spec records `corvint test` sharing the narrowed plan as a non-goal of AFP-V0-050.
title: gateselect and `corvint test` still select every declared package when .corvint/test-read-scopes.json changes (AFP-V0-050 narrowing applies only to `corvint affected`)
